overview.en: Uromys emmae is a giant rat in the family Muridae, known from Owi Island in Papua Province, Indonesia.
overview.fr: Uromys emmae est un rat géant de la famille des Muridae, connu de l’île d’Owi, dans la province de Papouasie en Indonésie.

identification.en: Its formal description rests on one museum specimen, so field identification has not been documented.
identification.fr: Sa description scientifique repose sur un seul spécimen de musée ; son identification sur le terrain n’est donc pas documentée.

habitat.en: The IUCN account presumes tropical moist forest, while noting that the species’ natural history is unknown.
habitat.fr: La fiche de l’UICN suppose qu’il vit en forêt tropicale humide, tout en précisant que son histoire naturelle demeure inconnue.

diet.en: No diet has been recorded for this species.
diet.fr: Aucun régime alimentaire n’a été documenté pour cette espèce.

behavior.en: Its behavior is unknown because no natural-history observations are available in the assessment.
behavior.fr: Son comportement est inconnu, car l’évaluation ne dispose pas d’observations d’histoire naturelle.

reproduction.en: No reproductive biology has been recorded.
reproduction.fr: Aucune donnée sur sa reproduction n’a été publiée.

ecology.en: The Australian Museum review records one holotype from Owi Island and notes no later report of the species.
ecology.fr: La révision de l’Australian Museum mentionne un seul holotype de l’île d’Owi et aucune observation ultérieure de l’espèce.

conservation.en: The IUCN assessment lists it as Critically Endangered, Possibly Extinct, citing its tiny range, continuing habitat decline and failed searches.
conservation.fr: L’évaluation de l’UICN le classe en danger critique, possiblement éteint, en raison de son aire minuscule, du déclin continu de son habitat et de recherches infructueuses.

title.fr: Liste rouge de l’UICN — Uromys emmae

facts: The 2016 global assessment presumes moist forest, records no natural history, and lists Critically Endangered (Possibly Extinct).

title.fr: Australian Museum — révision du genre Uromys

facts: The taxonomic revision describes the species from one specimen and notes no later report.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: The IUCN assessment dates from 2016; “Possibly Extinct” is a qualifier within Critically Endangered, not confirmed extinction.
The assessment explicitly states that natural history is unrecorded; unknown diet and reproduction should not be interpreted as proof of absence.
review_note: This species is exceptionally poorly known: the account distinguishes the single-specimen record from the IUCN assessment’s presumed habitat and possible-extinction qualifier.
